question.problem:
Consider the quadratic form 
$Q(x)={x}_{1}^{2}-4{x}_{1}{x}_{2}+2{x}_{1}{x}_{3}-3{x}_{2}{x}_{3}.$ 
Evaluate $Q(x)$ when $x=[\begin{aligned}3 \\ -1 \\ 0\end{aligned}].$
question.worked_solution:
We are given that 

$$
x=[\begin{aligned}{x}_{1} \\ {x}_{2} \\ {x}_{3}\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}3 \\ -1 \\ 0\end{aligned}].
$$

Substituting this into the expression for $Q(x)$, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}Q(x) & ={x}_{1}^{2}-4{x}_{1}{x}_{2}+2{x}_{1}{x}_{3}-3{x}_{2}{x}_{3} \\  & ={3}^{2}-4\cdot 3\cdot (-1)+2\cdot 3\cdot 0-3\cdot (-1)\cdot 0 \\  & =9+12+0+0 \\  & =21.\end{aligned}
$$
